title: Normalize Imperative Plugin Crate to Consistency Contract
description: Normalize imperative/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the app-crate consistency contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item_with_action, PanelTreeBuilder, selection_ids) for build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree, adopt SDK Terminology (app_labels! macro, resolve_labels, localized_label_map, AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing the hand-rolled ImperativeLabels struct/consts/resolver and manual AppLabelsOverlay struct literal, adopt SDK testkit (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent) replacing local test scaffolding and the three generic-shaped test bodies, fix region naming/order (CommandLabels moved before Panels, tests wrapped in //#region 🧪️Tests), and verify C1 naming / resource_kind are already compliant. Scope: imperative/plugin/rs/** only. (Intended parent ticket 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES was not found/recognized by the MCP.)
summary:
Normalized imperative/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract by adopting the framework SDK's PanelKit, Terminology, and Testkit primitives.

C1 (naming): app id "imperative-play" already mapped to struct "ImperativePlayApp" — no rename needed.
C2 (registration region): already named "//#region 🔖️Manifest" — no rename needed.
C4 (layout): single-app crate, already flat (no wrapping mod) — no change needed.
Resource kind: .resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{...}) already present on the AppBuilder chain from the prior Wave-1 pass — verified only, not re-done.

Changes made:
- PanelKit: deleted the crate's local tree_item/tree_item_with_action fns; build_document_tree and build_catalogue_tree now use PanelTreeBuilder + the SDK's tree_item_with_action/selection_ids (setSelection handler now calls selection_ids(args) instead of hand-inlined ids-array parsing). build_inspector_tree is untouched (declarative-sections style, not a tree-boilerplate function).
- Terminology: replaced the hand-rolled `struct ImperativeLabels` + IMPERATIVE_LABELS_NATIVE_EN/DE consts + imperative_labels() resolver with semio_framework_plugin::app_labels! + resolve_labels::<ImperativeLabels>(view_state); replaced the manual (id,en,de)->HashMap loop in imperative_action_labels with localized_label_map; replaced the manual AppLabelsOverlay struct-literal in DocumentApp::app_labels with the AppLabelsOverlayExt fluent builder (AppLabelsOverlay::default().window_kind_label(...).window_kind_label(...).action_labels(...)) — confirmed no .app_label() method exists on the real overlay ext trait, none was needed here.
- Testkit: deleted the local meta()/new_app()/new_app_with_registry() scaffolding in favor of testkit::meta/testkit::new_app::<ImperativePlayApp>()/testkit::new_app_with_registry::<ImperativePlayApp>(create_imperative_app); replaced the three generic-shaped test bodies (undo_after_add_step_restores_original_document_exactly, two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone, ingest_operations_is_idempotent_for_imperative) with calls to testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip / testkit::assert_two_instances_converge / testkit::assert_ingest_idempotent, keeping this app's own action names/args/probes as closure arguments; deleted the now-dead step_params_contains helper and the direct MemoryBackbone/Backbone/BackboneMessage imports (no longer used directly). All other app-unique tests (app_definition_builds_without_panicking, add_step_materializes_kind_default_and_run_emits_no_ops, renders_table_scene, imperative_labels_resolve_native_by_default/in_german, renders_script_editor, default_document_has_steps, add_step_action_appends_step, add_step_at_owner_slot_nests_into_control_body, add_step_at_falls_back_to_root_for_unknown_owner, run_action_expands_scope_into_readable_rows_without_truncation, remove_step_action_is_exact_inverse_of_add) left with their original bodies, only swapping meta()/new_app() call sites for testkit:: equivalents.
- Region hygiene: moved the "🔖️CommandLabels" region to sit between Terminology and Panels (canonical order), and wrapped the test module in "//#region 🧪️Tests" / "//#endregion 🧪️Tests" (previously unwrapped).

Verified: rustfmt --check against the repo's rustfmt.toml (only cosmetic single-line-vs-multi-line diffs, same as pre-existing style noise, no structural issues); brace/paren/bracket balance (124/124, 575/575, 52/52); exhaustive grep cross-reference of every SDK symbol used (PanelTreeBuilder, tree_item_with_action, selection_ids, app_labels!, resolve_labels, is_de_locale, localized_label_map, AppLabelsOverlayExt, testkit::*) against the real signatures read directly from framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs's PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit regions (lines 1001-1617) and their crate-root re-export list (lines 4427-4436), confirming semio_framework_plugin::<name> paths resolve even though the items are physically declared inside `pub mod app` (re-exported via `pub use app::{...}` / `pub use app::testkit`); confirmed ImperativeDocument derives Clone/Debug/PartialEq (satisfies testkit's P: PartialEq + Debug bound); zero-residue grep sweep for old identifiers across imperative/** (only match is the new app_labels!-generated struct, expected).

Skipped: full `cargo check -p imperative-plugin` did not produce output after several minutes — `ps aux` confirmed 10+ concurrent cargo check processes from other sessions (mathematical-plugin, vcs, infinite_board, sequence-plugin x2, vcs-plugin, sourcing-plugin, protocol-plugin, remodel-plugin, plus mine) genuinely contending for the shared build lock, matching the documented lock-contention scenario. Did not block on it per verification policy; relying on the static verification above. Final compile confirmation deferred to the orchestrator's end-of-program cargo check --workspace gate.

Nothing about this crate's shape resisted the SDK primitives — no deviations to flag for Wave 4.
